Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study uses a BioID approach to identify proximal interactors of the BoDV-1 P protein. The primary biological variables are the expression of the viral bait protein (genetic perturbation via transgene) and the stimulation of the cells with poly(I:C) (immune receptor ligand stimulation). The design is factorial as it examines different bait tags (N- vs C-terminal) and different stimulation states (basal vs poly(I:C)).
